name: American Chopper Argument
look: Five stacked stills of a reality TV argument between Paul Teutul Sr., an older man with a gray mustache, and his son Paul Jr., in a black cap. They take turns yelling and pointing in an office, the son flings a chair, and the father points back furiously.
use: Each panel gets one line of a heated back-and-forth, with father and son arguing about something trivial or nerdy as if it were a matter of life and death.
slots: the son's angry reply (panel 4, chair throw)
examples: A hot dog is a sandwich
Bread on both sides with filling in the middle!
Then a taco is a sandwich too!
Don't you dare bring tacos into this!
describe: father and son yelling at each other in an office
two bikers arguing and one throws a chair
reality show screaming match in five panels
older man with a mustache and younger guy in a cap shouting and pointing
motorcycle builders in a heated argument with a chair thrown
origin: Stills of Paul Teutul Sr. and Paul Teutul Jr. arguing in an episode of the reality series American Chopper.
